schema.legacy_node_comparison: Unmodified apex.performance.compare_runs result, including its original rejection.

semantic_guard_comparison.accepted: All separately documented comparison checks passed.
semantic_guard_comparison.validated_replanned_speedup: accepted AND after actual makespan is shorter.
semantic_guard_comparison.task_guard_report: Task-ID reachability, actual task timing, skill identity, selected support order, buffer events.
semantic_guard_comparison.geometry_reports: New graph sampled-oracle certificate plus independently stored full rollout reports.

schema.scope: Two observed full runs. New route geometry and support order may differ; no isolated causal attribution to smoothing.

A.idle_scope: No active graph node; initial physical support holding is not free idle time.

B.idle_scope: No active graph node; initial physical support holding is not free idle time.

boundaries.definition: Consecutive same-arm pose->pose exits; nearest actual velocity sample only.

A.derivative_scope: Interval averages from measured velocity, nonuniform actual timestamps; no continuous extrema or jerk certification.

B.derivative_scope: Interval averages from measured velocity, nonuniform actual timestamps; no continuous extrema or jerk certification.

before.path_scope: Commanded joint polyline; endpoint chord is not a collision-free shortcut certificate.

A.idle_scope: No active graph node; initial physical support holding is not free idle time.

B.idle_scope: No active graph node; initial physical support holding is not free idle time.

boundaries.definition: Consecutive same-arm pose->pose exits; nearest actual velocity sample only.

A.derivative_scope: Interval averages from measured velocity, nonuniform actual timestamps; no continuous extrema or jerk certification.

B.derivative_scope: Interval averages from measured velocity, nonuniform actual timestamps; no continuous extrema or jerk certification.

after.path_scope: Commanded joint polyline; endpoint chord is not a collision-free shortcut certificate.

dependency_retention.scope: Original node IDs and reachability; unknown remapping fails conservatively.

limitations: Two actual runs, not a randomized or repeated robustness experiment.
Joint acceleration and jerk are sampled interval estimates; compare sampling before interpreting peaks.
Near-zero boundary observations are not exact counts of continuous physical stops.
Serial reference model time is not used as an experimentally measured baseline.

certificate.scope: sampled swept moving-phase conflicts; stationary waits, world changes and contact invariants require external validation

before.scope: Fresh sampled swept-path oracle plus full nominal world-state/idle rollout; not continuous collision certification.

certificate.scope: Current supplied node paths: sampled all-phase moving conflicts; refreshed scheduling, continuous-run gates and full world/waiting-state verification remain required.

after.scope: Fresh sampled swept-path oracle plus full nominal world-state/idle rollout; not continuous collision certification.

semantic_guard_comparison.old_geometry_edge_policy: Old motion_conflict edges are not required under changed paths. New actual edges and new sampled geometry/complete rollout must pass.
semantic_guard_comparison.support_order_policy: New selected before_gate/after_gate policy is enforced; old choice-specific Gate/removal serialization is not immutable.

limitations: New geometry and support order can change; speedup cannot be attributed to smoothing alone.
Boundary counts have different denominators after repartition; report observations and coverage, not only raw stop-count reduction.
Same physical/configuration hashes and actual feedback audits do not provide continuous collision or jerk guarantees.
